name: content-review
description: Local Content Review Platform: convenience scripts for running everything from the repository root.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend/admin-portal ci && npm --prefix frontend/author-portal ci
scripts.dev:all: dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others --names api,admin,author --prefix-colors blue,green,magenta "dotnet run --project backend/src/ContentReview.Api" "npm --prefix frontend/admin-portal run dev" "npm --prefix frontend/author-portal run dev"
